About_&_Key_Points:
About
Sikko Industries Ltd is an Ahmedabad-based agro-input formulator and marketer focused on pesticides, fertilisers and seeds. It sells through distributors/dealers to farmers and has its disclosed operating unit at Iyava on the Sanand–Viramgam Highway.
[1]
Key Points
Business & evolution
The business began with growth promoters/spray-pump assembly, added pesticides in 2008 and fertilisers in 2011; current revenue is from pesticides, fertilisers and seeds. Sprayers are a legacy/original-object business, while pharmaceuticals, agricultural commodities and, since April 2026, power/renewable-energy activities are only enabling objects/proposals; no revenue from these newer/legacy categories is separately reported.
